shiv.definition: n. a knife used as a weapon

shiva.definition: n. (Judaism) a period of seven days of mourning after the death of close relative

shivah.definition: n. (Judaism) a period of seven days of mourning after the death of close relative
shivah.translation: n. [希伯来语] 七日丧期 [亦作 shibah]

shivaree.definition: n. a noisy mock serenade (made by banging pans and kettles) to a newly married couple

shive.definition:
n. A slice; as, a shive of bread.
n. A thin piece or fragment; specifically, one of the scales or
   pieces of the woody part of flax removed by the operation of breaking.
n. A thin, flat cork used for stopping a wide-mouthed bottle;
   also, a thin wooden bung for casks.
shive.translation:
n. 碎片, 薄型软木塞
vt. 切, 戳

shively.translation: [人名] 夏夫利; [地名] [美国] 夏夫利

shiver.translation:
vi. 颤抖, 哆嗦, 被打碎
vt. 使迎风飘动, 粉碎
n. 战栗, 碎块

shivered.translation: v. （因寒冷, 害怕等）颤抖, 哆嗦( shiver的过去式和过去分词 )

shivering.definition:
n a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever
v tremble convulsively, as from fear or excitement
v shake, as from cold
s vibrating slightly and irregularly; as e.g. with fear or cold or like the leaves of an aspen in a breeze
shivering.translation:
n. 发抖, 打碎
[医] 战栗

shivers.definition:
n a reflex motion caused by cold or fear or excitement
n an almost pleasurable sensation of fright
v tremble convulsively, as from fear or excitement
v shake, as from cold
shivers.translation:
n. 寒战( shiver的名词复数 ); 寒噤（因恐惧或发高烧）
v. （因寒冷, 害怕等）颤抖, 哆嗦( shiver的第三人称单数 )

shivery.definition: s. cold enough to cause shivers
shivery.translation: a. 颤抖的, 令人悚然的, 寒冷的, 易碎的

shives.translation: 含木质下脚; 植物性杂质

shivoo.translation: [澳俚]兴高采烈的庆祝(宴)会, 吵闹的庆祝会

shivs.definition:
plural of shiv
n. a knife used as a weapon
shivs.translation: (shiv 的复数) n. 刀, 剃刀
